expectations.text: 以会话方式开始逐组跟练，而非输出 Markdown 报告
expectations.evidence: output.md opens follow-along mode, explicitly sets aside the three-day plan, starts the first set, and asks for results before the next set; it is not a report.

expectations.text: 先确认或给出第一组的动作、组数或目标次数、RIR 和休息提示
expectations.evidence: It provides a goblet-squat first set with target repetitions, RIR 3, load-selection guidance, and about two minutes of rest after an initial red-flag check.

expectations.text: 不声称已经记录或保存用户数据
expectations.evidence: output.md explicitly says it will not assume any record has already been saved; the transcript likewise records no persisted-log claim.
The only deliverable is the conversational output.md; no separately generated report is present or claimed.

execution_metrics.telemetry_note: Timing and token telemetry were not supplied for this baseline run.

claims.claim: The prior three-day-plan request is overridden by follow-along mode.
claims.evidence: Transcript records the override and output.md says the plan will not be expanded now.

claims.claim: The next set will be selected after the user reports four inputs.
claims.evidence: output.md asks for load, repetitions, remaining reps, and discomfort after the first set.
